articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a novel way to measure behavioral heterogeneity in a population of stochastic individuals. Our measure is choice-based; it evaluates the probability that, over a randomly selected menu, the sampled choices of two sampled individuals differ. We provide axiomatic foundations for this measure and a decomposition result that separates heterogeneity into its intrapersonal and interpersonal components.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种测量随机个体群体中行为异质性的全新方法。我们的度量基于选择；它评估在随机选取的菜单上，抽样的二个体的选择存在差异的概率。我们为该度量提供了公理基础，并给出了一个分解结果，将异质性分解为个体内和个体间两个组成部分。

articles.abstract_en: We study quality distortions when firms hold market power. We develop a model allowing for flexible functional forms of demand in order to extend Spence's (1975) monopoly analysis to imperfect competition. We show that quality distortions are determined by a competition effect that captures the externality a firm exerts on its competitors when raising both its price and its quality, in addition to Spence's (1975) effect related to the shape of total market demand. Our approach also allows us to analyze the effects of commodity taxation and technology shocks on the equilibrium allocation when firms compete in prices and qualities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了企业拥有市场力量时的质量扭曲。我们构建了一个允许需求函数形式灵活的模型，以将Spence（1975）的垄断分析扩展到不完全竞争。我们表明，质量扭曲由一种竞争效应决定，该效应捕捉了企业在同时提高价格和质量时对竞争对手施加的外部性，此外还有Spence（1975）关于总市场需求形状的效应。我们的方法还使我们能够分析在企业以价格和质量竞争时，商品税收和技术冲击对均衡配置的影响。

articles.title_en: The Organization of Innovation: Incomplete Contracts and the Outsourcing Decision
articles.title_cn: 创新的组织形式：不完全合同与外包决策
articles.abstract_en: Why do firms outsource research and development (R&D) for some products while conducting R&D in-house for similar ones? An innovating firm risks cannibalizing its existing products. The more profitable these products, the more the firm wants to limit cannibalization. We apply this logic to the organization of R&D by introducing a novel theoretical model in which developing in-house provides the firm more control over the new product's location in product space. An empirical analysis of our testable predictions using pharmaceutical data concerning patents, patent expiration, and outsourcing at various stages of the R&D process supports our theoretical approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 为什么企业会对某些产品的研发（R&D）选择外包，而对类似产品则进行内部研发？创新企业面临其新产品可能蚕食现有产品市场的风险。现有产品越有利可图，企业越希望限制这种蚕食。我们将这一逻辑应用于研发组织，提出一个新颖的理论模型，其中内部开发使企业能够更好地控制新产品在产品空间中的位置。基于制药行业关于专利、专利到期及研发过程各阶段外包的数据，我们对模型的可检验预测进行了实证分析，结果支持我们的理论方法。

articles.abstract_en: Complementarities and peer effects are common in matching markets, yet incorporating them often leads to nonexistence of stable matchings. We observe that matching is often an ongoing process rather than a static allocation, where long-lived firms interact over time with short-lived workers. We show that when wages are flexible and firms are sufficiently patient, a dynamically stable solution always exists in many-to-one matching markets—even with complementarities and peer effects. Flexible wages are crucial to our result, as they not only facilitate surplus extraction when firms cooperate in no-poaching agreements but also enhance the threat of punishment through bidding wars.
articles.abstract_cn: 互补性和同伴效应在匹配市场中普遍存在，然而将其纳入模型常常导致稳定匹配的不存在。我们观察到匹配通常是一个持续进行的过程，而非静态分配，其中长期存在的企业与短期存在的工人随时间互动。我们证明，当工资具有灵活性且企业足够耐心时，在多对多匹配市场中，即使存在互补性和同伴效应，也总存在动态稳定解。工资的灵活性对我们的结果至关重要，因为它不仅促进了企业在无挖角协议中合作时的剩余提取，还通过竞价战增强了惩罚威胁。

articles.title_en: Agency Pricing and Bargaining: Evidence from the E-Book Market
articles.title_cn: 代理定价与议价：来自电子书市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the pricing implications of wholesale and agency contracts when input terms are determined through bargaining. We develop a structural Nash-in-Nash bargaining model and show that the distribution of bargaining power determines whether agency contracts raise or lower retail prices relative to wholesale contracts. We apply the model to the e-book market, which transitioned from wholesale to agency contracts after the expiration of a ban on agency contracting. Estimates indicate that the retailers have most of the bargaining power. Counterfactual simulations show that most-favored-nation clauses raise prices but would lower the profits of the publishers and Amazon.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当投入条款通过议价确定时，批发合同和代理合同的定价影响。我们构建了一个结构性的纳什-纳什议价模型，表明议价权力的分布决定了代理合同相较于批发合同是提高还是降低零售价格。我们将该模型应用于电子书市场，该市场在代理合同禁令到期后从批发合同转向代理合同。估计结果表明零售商拥有大部分议价权。反事实模拟显示，最惠国条款会提高价格，但会降低出版商和亚马逊的利润。

articles.title_en: Strategic Evidence Disclosure in Networks and Equilibrium Discrimination
articles.title_cn: 网络中的战略性证据披露与均衡歧视
articles.abstract_en: A group of agents with ex ante independent and identically uncertain quality compete for a prize, awarded by a principal. Agents may possess evidence about the quality of those they share a social connection with (neighbors), and themselves. In one equilibrium, adversarial disclosure of evidence leads the principal to statistically discriminate between agents based on their number of neighbors (degree). We identify parameter values for which an agent's ex ante winning probability is monotone in degree. All equilibria that satisfy some robustness criteria lie between this adversarial disclosure equilibrium and a less informative one that features no snitching and no discrimination.
articles.abstract_cn: 一组具有事前独立且同分布不确定质量的代理人竞争由委托人颁发的奖项。代理人可能拥有关于其社交连接对象（邻居）及自身质量的证据。在一均衡中，证据的对抗性披露导致委托人基于代理人的邻居数量（度数）进行统计歧视。我们确定了使代理人事前获胜概率关于度数单调的参数值。所有满足某些稳健性标准的均衡介于该对抗性披露均衡与一个信息较少的一均衡之间，后者不涉及告密且不存在歧视。

articles.title_en: Opportunity Hunters: A Model of Competitive Sequential Inspections
articles.title_cn: 机会猎手：一种竞争性顺序检查模型
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a new type of games, called "opportunity-hunting games," in which two players compete to discover an uncertain event ("opportunity") that occurs at an unobserved and random point in time. Players can inspect whether the event has already occurred again and again, but each inspection is costly. Varying the parameters of the model spans the range from games where competition between the players to be the first to identify the opportunity is the dominant force, to games in which free riding on the other player's effort is the dominant force. We characterize the game's unique symmetric Markov perfect equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一类新型博弈，称为“机会猎手博弈”，其中二名玩家竞争发现一个不确定事件（“机会”），该事件发生在一个未被观察且随机的时间点。玩家可以反复检查该事件是否已经发生，但每次检查都需要付出成本。通过调整模型参数，可以涵盖从玩家之间竞争成为第一以识别机会的主导力量的博弈，到搭便车于其他玩家努力的主导力量的博弈。我们刻画了该博弈的唯一对称马尔可夫完美均衡。

articles.abstract_en: This paper measures concentration in narrowly defined product markets for a broad range of consumer goods and services in the United States from 1994 to 2019. We document two main empirical facts. First, concentration levels are high. Of the markets in our sample, 44.4 percent are "highly concentrated" as defined by US regulators. Second, market concentration has been decreasing since 1994. The median HHI falls from 2,362 to 2,045. These findings stand in stark contrast to the prior literature, which uses market definitions that are aggregated to a level that is typically too broad to accurately reflect competition in consumer markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文测量了美国从1994到2019期间一系列消费品和服务的狭义产品市场的集中度。我们记录了二个主要的实证事实。第一，集中度水平较高。在我们的样本市场中，44.4%个市场被美国监管机构定义为“高度集中”。第二，自1994以来，市场集中度一直在下降。中位数HHI从2,362降至2,045。这些发现与以往文献形成鲜明对比，后者使用的市场定义通常过于宽泛，难以准确反映消费市场的竞争状况。

articles.abstract_en: Does more information benefit voters? I examine this question in a novel setting of distributive politics and electoral accountability. Homogeneously informed electorates can benefit from less information through improvements in the control or screening of politicians. For heterogeneously informed electorates, I show that the distribution of resources and voter welfare is affected by the nature of informational heterogeneity and by voters' ability to communicate with each other, making less-informed voters better off than their more-informed counterparts in some cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 更多信息是否有利于选民？我在分配政治和选举问责这一新颖背景下探讨了这一问题。信息均质的选民群体通过对政治家的控制或筛选的改进，可能从较少的信息中受益。对于信息异质的选民群体，我表明资源分配和选民福利受到信息异质性的性质以及选民相互沟通能力的影响，在某些情况下，信息较少的选民比信息较多的选民更为受益。

articles.abstract_en: This paper examines efficient allocations in economies where consumers exhibit heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences and face model uncertainty with a common set of identifiable models. Aggregate endowment is ambiguous. We characterize economies where the representative consumer is of the smooth ambiguity type and derive efficient sharing rules. Heterogeneous ambiguity aversion leads to sharing rules that systematically differ from those in vNM economies. The representative consumer's ambiguity aversion differs from that of the typical consumer; this leads to more compelling asset-pricing predictions. We focus on point-identified models but show that our insights extend to partially identified models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了消费者表现出异质平滑模糊偏好且面临具有共同可识别模型集合的模型不确定性的经济中的有效配置。总禀赋存在模糊性。我们刻画了代表性消费者为平滑模糊类型的经济，并推导了有效的共享规则。异质的模糊厌恶导致共享规则系统性地不同于vNM经济中的规则。代表性消费者的模糊厌恶与典型消费者不同；这带来了更具说服力的资产定价预测。我们关注点识别模型，但表明我们的见解可扩展至部分识别模型。

articles.title_en: The Effect of Mergers on Innovation
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of a merger on R&D activity in a dynamic model with uncertainty about the feasibility of innovation. The merger has three effects: It may reduce the number of follow-up innovations (cannibalization effect), increase the probability of the first game-changer innovation (appropriability effect), and bring this innovation forward in time (informational effect). The model suggests mergers are more desirable when R&D outcomes are highly uncertain, but less so when the innovation path is clearer. A surprising policy implication is that the benefit of the merger may be higher if the first and subsequent innovations are closer substitutes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个关于创新可行性存在不确定性的动态模型中研究兼并对研发活动的影响。兼并具有多重效应：它可能减少后续创新的数量（蚕食效应），增加具有颠覆性意义的创新的概率（可占有性效应），并使该创新提前发生（信息效应）。模型表明，当研发结果高度不确定时，兼并更具吸引力；而当创新路径较为明确时，兼并的吸引力则较低。一个令人意外的政策启示是，如果颠覆性创新及其后续创新是更为接近的替代品，兼并的收益可能更高。

articles.title_en: On Taking a Skewed Risk More than Once
articles.title_cn: 关于多次承担偏斜风险
articles.abstract_en: Penny-picking refers to the often-observed phenomenon of repeatedly taking negatively skewed risks and seems directly at odds with evidence on (positive-)skewness-seeking as observed in static settings. We show that penny-picking may not only occur despite skewness-seeking, but—seemingly paradoxically—because of skewness-seeking. With sufficient time available, risks with arbitrary negative skewness can be gambled in such a way that, overall, skewness is positive. Therefore, classical behavioral theories like prospect theory straightforwardly explain penny-picking. More generally, we show that the versatile dynamics of skewness reconcile apparent preference reversals concerning the avoidance and acceptance of (skewed and non-skewed) risks.
articles.abstract_cn: “捡便宜”指的是反复承担负偏斜风险的常见现象，这似乎与静态环境中观察到的（正）偏斜寻求行为直接矛盾。我们表明，“捡便宜”不仅可能在偏斜寻求行为存在的情况下发生，而且——看似矛盾地——正是由于偏斜寻求行为而发生。在有足够时间的情况下，可以以一种总体上使偏斜为正的方式赌博任意负偏斜的风险。因此，经典行为理论如前景理论可以直接解释“捡便宜”现象。更一般地，我们展示了偏斜的多样动态如何调和关于规避和接受（偏斜及非偏斜）风险的表面偏好逆转。

articles.title_cn: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性
articles.abstract_en: We study the possibility of identifying time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0 and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be "priced out."
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在经验设计中识别时间不一致偏好的可能性，该设计中偏好先在时间0被引出，然后在代理人获得额外信息后于时间1再次引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间1对一对备选方案的排序总是时间0排序的完全相反时，时间一致性才被拒绝。我们建立了该结果的变体和推广。由于如此明显的逆转很少被观察到，选择修正设计需要比之前可能认识到的更强的识别假设。但我们表明，在备选方案的偏好可以被“定价”出来的环境中，时间不一致性是可识别的。
